sections.subtitle: PLANS & SUPPORT
sections.title: Choose the support setup that fits.
sections.content: Start with your website and support workspace. Add AI assistance with Growth.

items.title: Is AI assistance included in Starter?
items.description: No. AI assistance is part of Growth. Starter includes the website, product catalogue and support workspace.

items.title: Can my team take over a conversation?
items.description: Yes. Your team can take over a conversation with the available conversation context.

items.title: What information can AI use?
items.description: Your configured FAQs, business information and product knowledge help provide relevant context.

items.title: Are there usage or provider limits?
items.description: Usage allowances and provider limits are confirmed before activation.
